policy: Skeleton + mapping layer written by Claude (the knowledge-dense part). Every related_eastern_diseases id exists in tdis_registry.json; every related_patterns id exists in pattern_library.json. Prose fields (summary, red_flags, western_context, seeds) are E3 fill batches — a condition may NOT render until red_flags is filled. All draft / needs_source_review. Mappings are study references, not diagnostic equivalence claims.

records.summary_zh: 多囊性卵巢症候群是育齡女性常見的內分泌與代謝失調，特徵為排卵稀少或不排卵、雄性素過高表現（如多毛、痤瘡）與超音波多囊卵巢型態，常伴月經稀發及不孕。診斷多採 Rotterdam 標準（三取二），並需排除其他高雄性素病因。
records.summary_en: PCOS is a common reproductive-age endocrine and metabolic disorder marked by oligo-/anovulation, clinical or biochemical hyperandrogenism, and polycystic ovarian morphology, often with irregular cycles and subfertility. Diagnosis commonly uses the Rotterdam criteria (2 of 3) after excluding other causes of hyperandrogenism.
red_flags_zh: 異常大量或持續子宮出血需評估子宮內膜病變
長期無月經合併子宮內膜增厚，需排除內膜增生／癌變
突發嚴重骨盆腔痛需排除卵巢扭轉或其他急症
疑似懷孕
急劇雄性素上升或男性化需排除分泌雄性素之腫瘤
red_flags_en: Abnormally heavy or prolonged uterine bleeding — evaluate the endometrium
Prolonged amenorrhea with thickened endometrium — rule out hyperplasia/carcinoma
Sudden severe pelvic pain — rule out ovarian torsion or other acute cause
Possible pregnancy
Rapid virilization or steeply rising androgens — rule out an androgen-secreting tumor
records.western_context_zh: 臨床上常以生活型態調整、體重管理與依生育需求選用之藥物（如排卵誘導、口服避孕藥調經、胰島素敏感化劑）進行處置；此處僅為文件對照用語，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with lifestyle modification, weight management, and — depending on fertility goals — agents such as ovulation induction, combined oral contraceptives for cycle regulation, or insulin sensitizers. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.
records.etiology_zh:
月經稀少或閉經，絕對是困擾中國人千年以上的議題，自古便有豐富的醫療記錄。

例如，《金匱要略》提到「經水不利」，《諸病源候論》稱之為「月候不利」，《丹溪心法》和《證治準繩》則記載「經水澀少」，而《婦人良方》和《女科經論》亦使用「月水不利」的表述。

這些文獻顯示中國人對此症狀有上千年的經驗積累，值得我們參考。

傳統中醫認為，月經稀少或閉經與「腎氣虧損」密切相關。先天腎氣不足，或產後失血過多，可能導致精血虧虛。

此外，「氣血兩虛」也被視為主要原因之一，表現為月經量減少甚至停閉，並伴隨小腹無脹痛、面色萎黃、頭暈心悸、神疲乏力等症狀。

情緒因素亦不可忽視，情緒低落可能導致肝氣鬱結，進一步引發「氣滯血瘀」，這會引起月經停止，並伴隨小腹脹痛或拒按、精神抑鬱、胸悶脅痛、性情急躁易怒等。

古代中國人對於治療月經稀少閉經很有經驗

中醫認為，體內濕氣過重引起的「痰濕阻滯」會導致月經逐漸減少，甚至閉經。這類患者通常體型肥胖，腰酸浮腫，伴隨胸悶惡心、食欲不振、乏力，舌苔多為白膩。

歸納以上，主要與「脾腎陽虛」有關，陽虛進而導致痰濕堆積，阻塞經絡運行。

這些觀念構成了中國人數千年來對於月經稀少的基本看法，並在一定程度上具有其準確性。

然而，這些傳統概念相對抽象，若能以現代化、數據化的方式進行解析，將更有助於發現問題的根本原因。

通過經絡檢測，只要找到受到「閉經」困擾的女性，直接觀察其經絡體質現象，從而挖掘背後的真正病因。

自2020年疫情以來，雲端中醫平台已累積了大量與經絡相關的數據。若進一步分析這些數據，可以歸納出兩個特點。

1.寒性陽虛體質為主

傳統中醫認為，月經稀少甚至必經的女性是氣血虛弱的。女性在本質上屬於陰性，所以這種虛弱很可能就是源自於寒虛體質。

理論如此，事實上也是這樣，這裡舉一個真實案例。某會員月經稀少差不多半年了，前兩個月開始沒有月經。

在2024年進入冬季12月之後，她感到火氣非常大，出現口臭、夜間容易醒來、牙齒痛、胸悶脹痛...等等症狀。

女性閉經，進入冬季之後火氣大，卻呈現一派陽虛經絡型態

然而，他的經絡圖呈現典型的「一派陽虛」經絡型態，除了三焦經顯現實證外，幾乎沒有明顯的火氣徵象。

她的案例正好驗證了雲端中醫在冬季常提到的一種現象：每年12月至次年1月期間，有一部分人會表現出火氣旺盛的情況。

此外，他的體能數值僅為23，這是典型的氣血不足表現，印證了傳統中醫所說的「氣血虛弱」可能引發閉經的觀點。

這個案例也表明，閉經與「寒性陽虛經絡體質」有一定的關聯性，這種體質長期「腎陽虛」，也印證了腎虛會導致閉經的原因。

她的案例只是眾多類似情況中的一例。對於任何月經稀少或閉經的女性，只要長期觀察自己的經絡數據，就能判斷是否屬於「寒性陽虛經絡體質」，作為管理健康的參考依據。

2.手三陰經虛證

從不少數據中發現，月稀少或閉經的女性，經絡圖上很容易看到「手三陰經」(肺經、心經與心包經)虛證。

由於這三條經絡虛症，伴隨的經絡型態，有可能是「鐵三角經絡型態」，也可能是「上虛上實」，所以女性只要是「手三陰經」虛證，都有可能出現月經稀少或閉經。

《諸病源候論》中有提到原因，原文是：「婦人月水不利者，由勞傷血氣，致令體虛而受風冷；風冷客於胞內，損傷衝任之脈，手太陽、少陰之經故也。衝脈、任脈為經脈之海，皆起於胞內；手太陽小腸之經也，手少陰心之經也，此二經為表裡，主下為月水。風冷客於經絡，搏於血氣，血得冷則壅滯，故令月水來不宣利也。」

白話的意思是：女性月經不正常的現象，是因為過度勞累導致氣血虛弱，進而受風寒侵襲。這些風寒之氣滯留在子宮內，損害了衝脈和任脈，而衝脈和任脈是經絡系統的海洋，它們都起於子宮。手太陽小腸經和手少陰心經是相表裡的經脈，它們負責主導月經的排出。風寒之氣侵犯經絡後，與氣血發生衝突。當氣血受到寒氣影響時，就會變得凝滯，從而導致月經不順暢。

千言萬語不如直接舉一個例子，某會員被醫生診斷為多囊卵巢綜合症，年紀輕輕就停經了，只能依賴荷爾蒙療法，持續服用了一年。

後來他心想，一直服用荷爾蒙不是辦法，就開始運用中藥，果然很有效。然而，在夏季的時候還算穩定，進入冬季之後就沒效果了。

而2024年進入冬季之後，她的經絡圖就明顯呈現「手三陰經」(肺經、心經與心包經)虛證，同時體能數值極低(20以下)。

最奇特的是，她的寒熱指數「上下皆熱」，所以也是感到火氣很大，很容易口渴。由於氣血虛弱導致她面色暗沉，整天打哈欠想睡覺，經常可以連續睡十幾個小時。

女性進入冬季之後閉經，手三陰經虛證且火氣大

後來別人告訴她，是因為吃中藥的量不夠多，因為她過去每天只吃1次中藥，改吃一天3次之後，月經兩天後就來了。

她分享改善閉經的中藥組成其實很單純，就只有「四物湯」＋「香附」＋「桂枝」而已，希望可以幫助到需要的人。

「手三陰經」虛證代表心臟、肺臟氣血不足，這會導致閉經的現象？

許多人覺得這個好像沒什麼關係，事實上連現代醫學都研究發現，月經週期與心臟健康呈現正相關，月經不規律罹患心臟病的機率較高。

中國的道家也認為，心臟與月經是有關係的。女性的乳汁和月經均由氣血所化生，並通過經絡的運行達到乳房或子宮。

以上兩個案例都發生在冬季，如果這個時候去看中醫，吃中藥的效果通常不好，或是中藥的劑量要加大。

原因也很簡單，因為這類人在冬季體能數值低下，一直要等到隔年的4月才會明顯改善，就算是服用中藥改善的程度也可能有限。

如果在寒冷的冬季要快速改變這種現象，最好的法就是多運動，溫暖自己的身體配合中藥調養。簡單說就是讓自己的環境轉變成跟夏季一樣，這就很可能在冬季，也可以順利改善閉經的現象。

冬季容易出現子宮虛寒的現象

寒冷的冬季，會造成子宮寒，進而造成閉經。所以有一些女性，在冬季的時候月經比較不正常，這就是季節對體質造成的影響。

從中醫的角度來看月經稀少或閉經，其實原因是這麼單純，主要就是因為體內虛寒造成氣血運行不暢，只要運用正確的中藥，配合運動或經絡拍打活絡氣血，就可以改善月經稀少或閉經。
records.etiology_en:
Oligomenorrhea and amenorrhea have troubled Chinese patients for well over a thousand years, and there is a rich body of historical medical records on the subject.

For example, the Jin Gui Yao Lue (Essentials from the Golden Cabinet) refers to it as "unfavorable menstrual flow" (經水不利); the Zhu Bing Yuan Hou Lun (General Treatise on the Causes and Manifestations of Diseases) calls it "unfavorable menstrual timing" (月候不利); the Dan Xi Xin Fa (Danxi's Mastery of Medicine) and Zheng Zhi Zhun Sheng (Standards for Diagnosis and Treatment) record it as "scanty and rough menstrual flow" (經水澀少); and the Fu Ren Liang Fang (Effective Prescriptions for Women) and Nu Ke Jing Lun (Discourse on Gynecology) also use the term "unfavorable menstrual water" (月水不利).

These texts show that Chinese medicine has accumulated over a thousand years of clinical experience with this symptom, experience well worth drawing on.

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that oligomenorrhea and amenorrhea are closely related to "kidney qi deficiency." Congenital insufficiency of kidney qi, or excessive postpartum blood loss, can lead to depletion of essence and blood.

In addition, "dual deficiency of qi and blood" is regarded as another major cause, presenting as reduced menstrual flow or even amenorrhea, together with a lower abdomen that is not distended or painful, a sallow complexion, dizziness, palpitations, and fatigue.

Emotional factors should also not be overlooked: a depressed mood can lead to liver qi stagnation, which in turn provokes "qi stagnation with blood stasis." This can cause menstruation to stop, accompanied by lower-abdominal distension and pain that resists pressure, depressed mood, chest and hypochondriac tightness and pain, and irritability.

Ancient Chinese physicians had considerable experience treating oligomenorrhea and amenorrhea

Chinese medicine holds that excessive internal dampness causing "phlegm-damp obstruction" leads to progressively scanty menstruation and even amenorrhea. Such patients are typically overweight, with lower back soreness and edema, accompanied by chest tightness, nausea, poor appetite, and fatigue, with a white, greasy tongue coating.

In summary, the above patterns are mainly related to "spleen-kidney yang deficiency," in which yang deficiency leads to accumulation of phlegm-damp that obstructs the flow of the channels.

These concepts form the basic Chinese understanding of oligomenorrhea accumulated over thousands of years, and they hold a degree of validity.

However, these traditional concepts are relatively abstract; analyzing them in a modern, data-driven way can help uncover the root cause of the problem more effectively.

Through meridian (channel) measurement, women troubled by amenorrhea can be directly observed for their meridian-constitution patterns, allowing the true underlying cause to be uncovered.

Since the pandemic began in 2020, the CloudTCM platform has accumulated a large volume of meridian-related data. Further analysis of this data reveals two notable characteristics.

1. A cold, yang-deficient constitution predominates

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that women with oligomenorrhea or even amenorrhea have weakened qi and blood. Because women are constitutionally yin in nature, this weakness is likely rooted in a cold, deficient constitution.

This is the theory, and in practice it holds true as well — consider a real case. One member had experienced scanty menstruation for about six months, and had had no period at all for the preceding two months.

After entering winter in December 2024, she felt a strong sensation of internal heat ("huo qi"), with symptoms including bad breath, frequent night waking, toothache, and chest tightness and distension.

A woman with amenorrhea who felt strong heat symptoms after entering winter, yet whose meridian pattern showed uniform yang deficiency

However, her meridian chart showed a typical pattern of "uniform yang deficiency" — aside from an excess pattern in the triple burner (sanjiao) channel, there was almost no clear sign of internal heat.

Her case confirms a phenomenon CloudTCM often notes in winter: from December through January each year, a subset of people present with symptoms of exuberant internal heat.

In addition, her overall energy (vitality) score was only 23, a typical sign of insufficient qi and blood, corroborating the traditional Chinese medicine view that "qi and blood weakness" can give rise to amenorrhea.

This case also shows that amenorrhea has a definite association with a "cold, yang-deficient meridian constitution." Such a constitution reflects long-standing kidney-yang deficiency, further confirming that kidney deficiency can be a cause of amenorrhea.

Her case is just one of many similar examples. For any woman with oligomenorrhea or amenorrhea, long-term observation of her own meridian data can help determine whether she has a "cold, yang-deficient meridian constitution," providing a reference point for health management.

2. Deficiency patterns in the three hand yin channels

Data show that in many women with oligomenorrhea or amenorrhea, the meridian chart readily shows deficiency patterns in the "three hand yin channels" (lung, heart, and pericardium channels).

Because these three channels are deficient, the accompanying meridian pattern may be the "iron triangle pattern" or an "upper deficiency, upper excess" pattern. Therefore, any woman with deficiency in the "three hand yin channels" may present with oligomenorrhea or amenorrhea.

The Zhu Bing Yuan Hou Lun explains the cause as follows: "When a woman's menstrual flow is unfavorable, it is because overexertion has damaged her qi and blood, leaving the body deficient and susceptible to wind-cold. Wind-cold lodges within the uterus, injuring the penetrating (chong) and conception (ren) vessels — the channels of the hand taiyang and hand shaoyin. The chong and ren vessels are the 'sea of the channels' and both arise from within the uterus; the hand taiyang is the small intestine channel and the hand shaoyin is the heart channel, and these two channels stand in an exterior–interior relationship, governing the descent of menstrual blood. When wind-cold lodges in the channels and contends with qi and blood, the blood becomes congealed and stagnant when it encounters cold, causing menstrual flow to be unfavorable."

In plain language: irregular menstruation occurs because overexertion weakens qi and blood, leaving the body vulnerable to invasion by wind-cold. This wind-cold lingers within the uterus and damages the chong and ren vessels, which are the "sea" of the channel system and both originate from the uterus. The hand taiyang small intestine channel and the hand shaoyin heart channel form an exterior–interior pair and are responsible for governing the discharge of menstrual blood. Once wind-cold invades the channels, it conflicts with qi and blood; when qi and blood are affected by cold, they become congealed and stagnant, resulting in irregular, unfavorable menstrual flow.

Rather than more explanation, consider a direct example: one member was diagnosed by a physician with polycystic ovary syndrome and had stopped menstruating at a young age, relying on hormone therapy for a full year.

She later decided that continuing hormone therapy indefinitely was not a solution, and began using Chinese herbal medicine, which proved quite effective. However, while her condition remained fairly stable in summer, the herbs stopped working once winter arrived.

After entering winter in 2024, her meridian chart clearly showed deficiency in the "three hand yin channels" (lung, heart, and pericardium), together with an extremely low energy score (below 20).

Most unusually, her cold-heat index showed "heat throughout, upper and lower," so she also felt strong internal heat and was frequently thirsty. Qi and blood weakness left her complexion dull, and she yawned and felt sleepy all day, at times sleeping more than ten hours at a stretch.

A woman who developed amenorrhea after entering winter, with deficiency in the three hand yin channels and strong internal heat

She was later told that the herbal dosage had simply been insufficient — she had previously been taking the herbs only once a day. After increasing to three times a day, her period arrived within two days.

She shared that the herbal formula that resolved her amenorrhea was actually very simple — just Si Wu Tang (Four Substances Decoction) plus xiang fu (Cyperi Rhizoma) and gui zhi (Cinnamomi Ramulus) — in the hope that it might help others in need.

Does deficiency in the "three hand yin channels" — reflecting insufficient qi and blood in the heart and lungs — actually cause amenorrhea?

Many people assume there is no real connection, but in fact even modern medical research has found a positive correlation between menstrual cycle regularity and cardiovascular health, with irregular menstruation associated with a higher risk of heart disease.

Chinese Daoist thought likewise holds that the heart and menstruation are connected. Both breast milk and menstrual blood are transformed from qi and blood, which reach the breast or uterus through the movement of the channels.

Both cases above occurred in winter. Seeking Chinese medicine treatment during this season often yields poorer results from herbal medicine, or requires a larger dosage.

The reason is straightforward: such individuals have low energy scores in winter that do not clearly improve until April of the following year, so even with herbal treatment the degree of improvement may be limited.

To rapidly change this pattern during the cold winter months, the best approach is more physical exercise, warming the body, combined with herbal conditioning. In short, replicating conditions similar to summer can make it possible to successfully resolve amenorrhea even in winter.

Uterine cold-deficiency is common in winter

Cold winter weather can cause uterine cold, which in turn leads to amenorrhea. This is why some women experience more irregular menstruation in winter — a reflection of how season affects constitution.

From the perspective of Chinese medicine, the cause of oligomenorrhea and amenorrhea is actually this straightforward: internal cold-deficiency impairs the smooth flow of qi and blood. With the correct herbal formula, combined with exercise or meridian tapping to invigorate qi and blood, oligomenorrhea and amenorrhea can be improved.
records.western_pathology_zh:
月經稀少是指月經量明顯減少，甚至經期縮短至不足兩天，嚴重時會月經停止，出現閉經。

現代醫學認為，月經量少常見原因包括荷爾蒙變化、壓力、生活方式、飲食習慣、甲狀腺功能異常、多囊卵巢症候群（PCOS），涉及子宮、卵巢、垂體、下丘腦等多個部位的功能異常。

月經稀少和閉經在現代醫學中的治療方法，主要運用「荷爾蒙療法」，使用口服避孕藥或其他荷爾蒙製劑，來調節月經週期。

亦可透過調整生活方式，例如適度運動、減輕壓力、保持健康體重改善月經問題。心理因素會導致月經異常，透過心理諮詢或治療可能有助於緩解症狀。

如果運用這些方法效果都不好的話，也可以嘗試從中醫經絡臟腑的角度，來探討月經稀少或閉經現象，也可以提供不同的思路。
records.western_pathology_en:
Oligomenorrhea refers to a marked reduction in menstrual flow, or menstrual periods shortened to less than two days; in severe cases, menstruation may stop altogether, resulting in amenorrhea.

Modern medicine attributes scanty menstruation to common causes such as hormonal changes, stress, lifestyle, diet, thyroid dysfunction, and polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), involving dysfunction at multiple sites including the uterus, ovaries, pituitary gland, and hypothalamus.

Modern medical treatment of oligomenorrhea and amenorrhea mainly relies on hormone therapy, using oral contraceptives or other hormonal agents to regulate the menstrual cycle.

Lifestyle adjustments — such as moderate exercise, stress reduction, and maintaining a healthy body weight — can also help improve menstrual problems. Since psychological factors can cause menstrual irregularity, counseling or psychotherapy may help relieve symptoms.

When these approaches prove ineffective, exploring oligomenorrhea or amenorrhea from the perspective of Chinese medicine's channels and organ systems can offer an alternative approach.
herb_formulas: 當歸四逆加吳茱萸生薑湯
records.classical_references_zh:
《蘭室秘藏．婦人門》："婦人脾胃久虛，或形羸氣血俱衰，而致經水斷絕不行。或病中消胃熱，善食漸瘦，津液不生。夫經者血脈津液所化，津液既絕，為熱所灼，肌肉消瘦，時見渴燥，血海枯竭，病名曰血枯經絕。宜瀉胃之燥熱，補益氣血，經自行矣。…或因勞心，心火上行，月事不來，安心和血、瀉火，經自行矣。故《內經》云：月事不來者，胞脈閉也。胞脈者，屬心而絡於胞中，今氣上迫肺，心氣不得下通，故月事不來也。"

《濟陰綱目．調經門》："脈經曰：有一婦人來診，言經水少，不如前者何也？師曰：曾更下利，若汗出小便利者可。何以故？師曰：亡其津液，故令經水反少。"《女科經綸．月經門》："脈經曰：尺脈滑，血氣實，婦人經脈不利；尺脈來而斷絕者，月水不利，寸關如故，尺脈絕不至者，月水不利，當患少腹痛；肝脈沉，月水不利，主腰腹痛。"

records.summary_zh: 子宮內膜異位症指子宮內膜組織生長於子宮腔外（常見於卵巢、腹膜、子宮薦韌帶），造成慢性骨盆腔痛、經痛、性交痛與不孕；確診多需腹腔鏡與病理，影像可輔助評估卵巢子宮內膜異位瘤。
records.summary_en: Endometriosis is the presence of endometrial-like tissue outside the uterine cavity (commonly ovary, peritoneum, uterosacral ligaments), causing chronic pelvic pain, dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, and infertility. Definitive diagnosis usually needs laparoscopy with histology; imaging helps assess endometriomas.
red_flags_zh: 急性劇烈骨盆腔痛需排除卵巢子宮內膜異位瘤破裂或扭轉
腸道或膀胱周期性出血提示深部浸潤，需專科評估

Cyclical bowel or bladder bleeding suggests deep infiltrating disease — refer for specialist assessment

records.etiology_zh:
月經不調，也稱為月經失調，這絕對是困擾中國人千年以上的症狀，可以說中醫婦科有一大半都是在調經。

月經不調範圍很大，主要是指月經沒有一定規律，或先或後，也被稱為「經行先後無定期」，亦稱「月經紊亂」。

傳統中醫認為，造成月經失調的原因很多，例如：先天體質偏寒偏熱、壓力太大、過度勞累熬夜、飲食不當或藥物影響等，都可能使肝、脾、腎臟腑功能失常及氣血失調，而導致月經異常。

造成月經失調的中醫證候也很多，例如：氣虛、血虛、腎虛、體內陰寒、氣滯血瘀或痰濕、血熱、陰虛火旺...等等，這都有可能造成月經不調。

雲端中醫常常有一些讀者寫信來說，他們很喜歡中醫，但是總覺得中醫很難理解，像這樣複雜的月經不調原因，究竟該如何學習呢？

其實，學中醫的目的如果是要醫治成千上萬個病患，那確實是非常困難，但是如果只是要改善「自己」或「家人」的月經不調，那是簡單到不行。只要直接幫自己或家人進行經絡檢測，觀察經絡數值與型態，清楚不過的數據圖表就直接給你答案！

以下從經絡數據的角度，結合探討傳統中醫月經不調的證候，歸納出主要幾種原因：

1. 月經不調基本模型(肝、脾、腎不調)

由於月經不調的女性實在太多了，因此雲端中醫資料庫裡相關的經絡數據也非常多，要找出月經不調的最原始模型，最好的方法是找一位年輕、無病卻月經失調的女性來檢測，就可以看出月經不調最原始的樣貌。

從某會員的19歲女兒，她從第一次月經到現在已經第5年，以前都是正常的，在施打第一劑新冠疫苗之前，月經就開始延後約1-2個星期，在施打疫苗第1劑之後就更加明顯了，經常超過兩個月以上月經還不來。

在2022年7月底時，她已經打了第3劑新冠疫苗，距離上一次月經已經超過70天，當天的經絡型態如下圖：

19歲女性距離上次月經超過70天

只要經常閱讀雲端中醫文章的讀者都會知道，這就是典型的「鐵三角」經絡型態。這種經絡型態肝經實證、脾經與膀胱經虛證，最容易出現各種「肝脾不調」的症狀，這很有可能就是「月經不調」的最核心基本模型。

這位會員說：「女兒每天都很晚睡，每天深夜還在玩手遊，上一次月經也是去醫院打針才來的，讓我很頭痛！」「她的手遊朋友也一樣，每天都深夜3點睡，月經已經超過3個月沒來了！」

然而，這只是一位19歲女性的月經不調經絡型態，20-45歲之間的型態又是如何呢？從大量現代女性的經絡數據中發現，不少月經不調的女性，都是以「鐵三角」為基礎來產生的變化型，最常出現下圖的經絡型態：

20-45歲之間容易出現月經不調經絡型態

從上圖可以看到，這還加上了腎經虛證，尤其是20歲以上的女性很容易出現，這可以說更是畫龍點睛。肝經實證，加上脾經、腎經與膀胱經虛證，形成完美的鐵三角經絡型態，這可以說就是月經不調的最基本模型。

這一種經絡型態，可以用來解釋傳統中醫所說的脾虛、腎虛、肝脾不調、血虛、氣血兩虛、氣滯血瘀或痰濕...等等所造成的月經不調。這麼多的中醫證候，背後的經絡圖卻幾乎是一樣的，這不是很簡單嗎？

當然，這句話是寫給已經閱讀過很多雲端中醫文章的讀者，如果還不能理解的人，請先閱讀其他相關文章。[@ad:1]

2. 血熱，陰虛化熱

上面提到月經延後，現在要探討月經提前、過多，甚至月經不止(崩漏)。傳統中醫認為，月經提前或量多常是血熱、血瘀、虛熱、脾虛或濕熱所造成，其中「血熱」為多，所以這理要探討所謂的「熱」。

大家可以仔細看看上面最多人出現月經不調的經絡型態，上面的三焦經與大腸經是實證的。這種鐵三角經絡型態只要長期保持在體內，有一天就會化熱，也可以說是一種「陰虛火旺」現象，這時候就容易出現月經提前或不止。

鐵三角經絡型態容易化熱

這裡提出一個真實案例，在2020年時，有一位49歲女性月經不止長達半年以上，斷斷續續時有時無，總是不會乾淨。那段期間她經常幫自己進行經絡檢測，總是出現脾經與膀胱經能量嚴重低下現象，分享其中一張經絡圖如下：

2020年月經不止長達半年以上

這張經絡圖上全身體能數值72，她的脾經竟然只有20上下，膀胱經更是低於20。同時三焦經與大腸經能量始終居高不下。直到2021年的時候她說：「月經終於從我的生命中消失了，因為進入更慘的階段！」

所謂的更慘階段，是因為她開始進入更年期，陸續出現更多症狀(夜間失眠、潮熱、盜汗、很容易生氣...等等)，所以這種經絡型態正無縫接軌成為「更年期症候群」。

所以只要理解這種經絡型態，除了可以理解月經不調的背後原因，更可以串連至「更年期症候群」，還有更多的疾病(乳癌、肺癌、大腸癌...等等)，學中醫開始是不是變得很簡單呢？

基於此，更可以推斷所謂的「鐵三角經絡型態」，應該就是直接影響人體的內分泌、免疫系統！

3. 體內陰寒，陽虛經絡型態

中醫常說：「十個女人九個虛寒！」既然如此，為什麼到現在為止，都沒有討論寒氣這件事呢？原因很簡單，因為這篇文章第一版是寫在夏季，這時候多數人體內是看不到陽虛經絡型態的。

再度回到本文最先提到的19歲女性案例，她在2022年冬天施打疫苗之後，就已經開始出現月經延遲現象，當時她體內的經絡現象呈現嚴重陽虛(體內陽經沒有能量)，完全與2022年夏天的經絡型態完全不一樣。

19歲月經延遲女性，在冬天時的經絡型態

因此可以說，造成這位女性月經不調的真正核心經絡現象，很有可能源自於體內深深的寒氣陽虛現象，而不是所謂的鐵三角經絡型態。

而重點來了：不少人在施打完新冠疫苗之後，都出現這種陽虛經絡型態，疫苗很有可能加深體內陽虛經絡現象，而體內寒氣不嚴重的人到了夏天就會自動消失！

就一般「亞健康狀態」的人而言，冬天會出現冬天的經絡型態，夏天會出現夏天的經絡型態，一年四季循環變化著。而真正健康的人，是一年四季都出現「平和經絡型態」(沒有異常經絡)。

由於她是年輕人，還不會出現固定的經絡體質現象，體內的寒氣在夏天時被隱藏住了，再加上整個夏天熬夜玩手遊，才出現夏天典型的鐵三角經絡型態。

讀到現在，各位讀者有沒有覺得被騙的感覺？究竟哪一種經絡型態才是造成月經不調的經絡型態呢？

其實雲端中醫沒有騙大家，因為這只是一位19歲年輕人的經絡模型，多數月經不調的女性數據都是在30歲以上，他們的經絡型態幾乎都是穩定呈現鐵三角＋陽虛，也就是下圖這種經絡型態：

35歲以上經常出現的綜合經絡型態

所以只要這位19歲女性繼續喝冰水、每天熬夜玩手遊，在30歲之後就會開始形成這種經絡體質，在50歲的時候出現更年期症候群，這完全就是可以被預測的。

只要家裡有一套經絡檢測系統的女性，在月經期間很容易出現這篇文章所提到的經絡型態，有些女性在月經期間感到寒冷、偏頭痛、頭暈、腰酸背痛...等等，其實都是冬季常見的膽經、胃經與腎經虛證所造成，這都可以親身驗證。

4. 氣血兩虛、胸腹經絡不通

傳統中醫認為，氣血虧虛的女性，最容易出現月經不調，從經絡怎麼看氣血虧虛呢？最直接的就是整體性的經絡數值(體能數值)，愈高代表氣血旺盛，愈低代表氣血不足。

月經延後的女性，多數體能數值較低。在炎熱夏天裡會偏低，在寒冷冬天裡會更低，這也就是驗證體內氣血虧虛最簡單方法。

然而，如果而一位女性如果體能數值很高，有沒有可能還是氣血虧虛呢？這是非常有可能的，如果一位女性的「脾經虛證」久了，由於脾是生血之源，自然也會出現氣血虧虛。

也是因為如此，氣血虧虛只是一種結果，而不是原因，真正的原因還是要從經絡型態來加以辨別探討。而有一種經絡型態也會出現月經不調，那就是神秘的「上虛下實」經絡型態。

2022年6月時就有一位女性會員分享，她的月經大約延後了2個星期，月經出現的第一天突然間像感冒一樣打噴嚏、狂流鼻水，鼻子感到很癢，當天的經絡型態呈現下圖：

上虛下實的經絡型態也有可能出現月經延後

由於她經常出現上虛下實的經絡型態，所以這可以說算是一種體質現象。這種經絡型態主要是通過胸部、腹部的經絡嚴重阻塞，在多數的時候也是體內陰寒所造成，可以參考這篇文章(點選開啟)。

改善月經不調的方法

不論中醫分析月經不調有多複雜，這篇文章探討的經絡型態卻是單純到不行，只要改善這一種經絡型態，月經不調就會自然消失，學中醫養生就會非常簡單！然而，問題就在於這種經絡型態很難改變。

再度回到上面提到的19歲女性，在父母的強烈要求下，逼她連續兩天晚上11點上床睡覺，不要玩手遊，第三天幫她進行經絡檢測，結果竟然出現「最佳養生典範」標章。女兒笑說：「這套經絡檢測系統，跟遊戲一樣好玩耶！」

連續兩天晚上11點入睡，不玩手遊

可惜的是，這位會員只有高興一天，因為這位19歲女性在連續兩天早睡之後，覺得自己精神奕奕，有實力晚睡，第三天之後開始深夜2點才睡。這位會員搖頭說：「看來這真是沒救了！」

在過去十年以上的時間裡，有為數眾多的會員親身驗證，只要是熬夜晚睡、壓力大時，就會出現這種鐵三角經絡型態，這是不分季節的。所以只要反過來說，早睡、放鬆、釋放內心壓力，就是改善月經不調的根本方法，運用經絡檢測可以反覆驗證。

由於經絡圖上會顯示異常經絡，只要哪一條經絡異常，就去拍打、按摩、刮痧、拔罐相關穴道，可以從本文的3D穴道頁面清楚查看，最常見的就是肝經、脾經、腎經與膀胱經4條經絡異常。

體內寒氣深重的女性，除了少喝冰水，吃寒涼食物外，可以配合熱性中藥，相關的中藥在本文中有提出，也可以找中醫師配合討論。

月經不調是女性常見的症狀，相關的經絡型態也常見，每一位女性一輩子都有可能遇到，因此本篇文章的內容學習起來，可以運用一輩子可以說是非常划算的！
records.western_pathology_zh:
月經失調是一種女性常見的困擾，但這不是一種疾病，而是女性月經週期、經期長度或出血量出現異常症狀的統稱。

現代醫學發現，女性正常的月經週期約為24-38天，每次經期約4-8天，而一次月經週期的出血量大約是35ml，通常不會超過80ml。

月經週期不規則，一般是身體內分泌的異常所造成，這是一個由腦部到卵巢、子宮內膜的複雜調控機制，主要調控的中樞為下視丘、腦下垂體與卵巢。

正常狀況下，女性第一次月經後的2年期間，月經容易出現不規則，這是正常的生理現象。2年後，女性如果太久月經沒來、月經持續時間太長等問題，就是月經不規則。

月經不規則的原因很多，例如：疾病、藥物(消炎藥、抗生素)、吸菸、熬夜、壓力、情緒、體重改變（比如過度減肥）、過度運動等。

一些疾病如腦下垂體腺瘤，卵巢疾病如「多囊性卵巢症候群」、子宮疾病(子宮內膜息肉、子宮腺肌症、子宮肌瘤)造成不正常出血...等等都會造成月經失調。

中醫婦科可以說是中醫的強項，有千年以上的歷史經驗，而其中一大半就是在改善月經不調，亞洲女性有不少人在出現月經不調時會尋找中醫治療，所以這是一個非常值得參考的醫療選項。

symptoms_zh: 腹部腫大但軀體四肢消瘦

records.classical_references_zh: 《景岳全書.婦人規》：「凡欲念不遂，沉思積鬱，心脾氣結致傷衝任之源，而腎氣日消，輕則或早或遲，重則漸成枯閉，此宜兼治心脾腎。」

records.summary_zh: 子宮肌瘤為子宮平滑肌之良性腫瘤，常見於育齡女性，可無症狀或引起經量過多、骨盆腔壓迫、頻尿與不孕，症狀與肌瘤大小及位置（黏膜下、肌壁間、漿膜下）相關。
records.summary_en: Uterine fibroids are benign smooth-muscle tumors of the uterus, common in reproductive-age women. They may be asymptomatic or cause heavy menstrual bleeding, pelvic pressure, urinary frequency, and infertility, depending on size and location (submucosal, intramural, subserosal).
red_flags_zh: 嚴重或持續出血導致貧血症狀（頭暈、心悸、氣短）需即時評估
急性劇痛提示肌瘤變性或帶蒂肌瘤扭轉
快速長大或停經後仍長大需排除惡性（子宮肉瘤）
壓迫症狀導致排尿或排便困難
red_flags_en: Severe or ongoing bleeding with anemia symptoms (dizziness, palpitations, dyspnea) — evaluate promptly
Acute severe pain suggests fibroid degeneration or torsion of a pedunculated fibroid
Rapid growth or growth after menopause — rule out malignancy (uterine sarcoma)
Mass effect causing urinary or bowel obstruction
records.western_context_zh: 依症狀與生育需求，處置範圍從觀察、藥物控制出血到子宮肌瘤切除或子宮切除等；此為文件對照用語，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Depending on symptoms and fertility goals, management ranges from observation and medical control of bleeding to myomectomy or hysterectomy. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.
records.etiology_zh:
子宮肌瘤確定是千年以來，持續困擾古代女性的疾病，但是古代中醫沒有這個名詞，替代名詞是「癥瘕」，這是指女性盆腔內生殖系統發生腫塊的一種疾病。

古人對於腫塊生於子宮者稱為「石瘕」，生於胞脈者稱為「腸覃」。子宮肌瘤的中醫觀，是一個從「氣滯」到「血瘀」再到「痰瘀互結」的動態過程，其根源在於肝、脾、腎功能的失和。

治療不僅僅是消除一個「肉團」，更是通過疏肝解鬱、健脾祛濕、補腎填精來恢復全身氣血水液的正常代謝，使沖任調和，胞宮潔淨。主要中醫證候如下：

1. 肝氣鬱結：氣機阻滯的起點

肝主疏泄，性喜條達，負責調暢全身氣機與情志。長期壓力、情緒抑鬱或憤怒未能宣發，最易導致肝氣鬱結。氣為血之帥，氣行則血行；氣滯則血行不暢，逐漸形成血瘀。

更為關鍵的是，足厥陰肝經的循行路線，正如《黃帝內經·靈樞》所述：「循股陰，入毛中，過陰器，抵小腹……」，直接環繞生殖器，到達小腹（胞宮所在）。

肝氣鬱結的人，肝經通往下腹部造成子宮疾病

因此，肝經的氣血鬱滯，會直接影響胞宮的氣血循環。當瘀血日久，積聚於子宮壁內，便成為肌瘤形成的物質基礎。故言「肌瘤之成，始於肝鬱，成於血瘀」。

2. 脾虛濕聚：痰濁生成的土壤

脾主運化，負責消化水穀、運化水濕。現代人飲食不節（嗜食生冷、油膩、甜食）、思慮過度或勞累，都會損傷脾氣，導致脾虛。

脾虛則運化水濕的功能減弱，體內多餘的水分無法正常代謝，便凝聚成濕濁，進一步濃縮則成為痰濁。這些痰濕是一種黏濁的病理產物，容易下注於胞宮。

當痰濁與前述肝鬱導致的瘀血相互搏結，便形成更為頑固的 「痰瘀互結」 型態，使得肌瘤逐漸增大、質地可能更為堅硬。

3. 腎氣虧虛：根本動搖的關鍵

腎為先天之本，藏精，主生殖，是衝任二脈的根源。腎氣虧虛，特別是腎陽不足，如同子宮缺乏陽光的溫煦，導致內生虛寒，寒性收引凝滯，使血液運行更加緩慢，加重了 「寒凝血瘀」 的狀況。

另一方面，若為腎陰不足，則陰虛內熱，虛火會持續灼傷血液，使其變得濃稠，導致 「虛熱灼血成瘀」。

腎的虧虛，使得身體失去修復和平衡的根本能力，瘀血更難消散，肌瘤也容易反覆發生。

腎陽不足的人，容易產生子宮疾病

4. 經絡陽虛：穩定建立體質

從大量現代人經絡數據中發現一個極為關鍵卻常被忽略的類型，是「寒氣陽虛」導致的膽、胃、腎三經虛衰，是子宮肌瘤形成的一個深層次、根本性的病機。

這不僅解釋了為何許多患者伴有全身性的虛寒症狀，也為治療指明了「溫陽通經」的大方向。

《黃帝內經》提到：「陽化氣，陰成形。」子宮肌瘤作為一個有形的「陰實」產物，其生長的根本環境之一，就是身體「陽氣」的溫煦與「氣化」功能不足。

當人體陽氣（尤以腎陽為核心）衰弱，陰寒之氣內生或外襲，便會導致血液與津液遇寒則凝，從「氣態」、「液態」凝滯為「固態」的瘀血與痰飲。

而這股寒氣，是沿著特定的經絡通道侵襲並停滯於胞宮的。其中，足少陽膽經、足陽明胃經、足少陰腎經這三條經脈通往下腹部，因其循行路線、生理功能與子宮直接關聯，成為寒邪侵襲的關鍵路徑。

中醫認為「腎主生殖」、「胞絡者，繫於腎」，腎經通過沖任二脈與胞宮緊密相連，為其提供根本的元陽與元陰。

腎陽是全身陽氣的根本，猶如鍋底之火。腎陽不足（命門火衰），則無法溫煦下焦與胞宮，導致宮寒。寒性凝滯，使經血無法順暢排出，久而成瘀。

腎陽虛不能溫暖脾陽（火不生土），會加重脾虛濕聚，形成寒濕。陽虛不固，帶脈弛緩，腎陽虛導致帶脈約束無力，下焦濕濁更易下注胞宮。

子宮肌瘤常見的經絡型態

從大量現代人的經絡數據中發現，膽經、腎經與胃經虛證連動性極高，尤其是胃經主幹直下腹部，正對子宮前方，與胞宮正面直接相關。

尤其是帶脈與膽經相關，帶脈環腰一周，約束縱行經絡。脾虛濕盛或肝鬱克脾，可致帶脈鬆弛，水濕下注胞宮，加重痰瘀。

中醫認為「婦人經孕產乳皆以血為用」，腎經與沖脈相關，此經絡為「血海」，任主胞胎，沖任二脈起於胞宮。若沖任氣血失調，血海蓄溢異常，易致瘀血痰濕滯留子宮。

所以從經絡體質的角度來看，一個人會長期出現子宮肌瘤瘤而不容易痊癒，關鍵就在於「寒性陽虛經絡體質」現象所造成的一個結果。

這三條經的虛寒並非孤立存在，而是構成一個協同惡化的循環：

起點：先天不足或後天耗損（過食生冷、熬夜、過勞）導致腎陽虛衰（根本）。

影響一：腎陽虛不能溫暖脾陽與胃陽，導致胃經虛寒（氣血源頭與通道），氣血生成不足且下行通道不暢。

影響二：腎陽虛與胃陽虛，導致全身陽氣衰弱，膽經少陽春生之氣無力生發（樞紐失靈），氣機鬱滯於側面。

三條為子宮提供氣血與溫煦、並負責其代謝廢物排出的關鍵經絡（正面、側面、根本）同時陷入「虛寒」狀態。

於是，寒氣、瘀血、痰濕在這片「低溫」的土壤（胞宮）中最易凝結、聚集，且難以被身體的陽氣所化散，最終頑固成瘤。

子宮肌瘤是一種器質性病變，如果你期待一種療法，能讓腫瘤瞬間消失，那最簡單就是去找西醫治療。

中醫的改善原理方法，是透過調整「內環境」，讓子宮肌瘤沒有孳生的環境，漸漸地就會自然消失，或在西醫的治療之下，改善速度加快。

中醫改善子宮肌瘤的原理，核心方法就是「活血化瘀」。既然從體質已經知道以寒性體質為主，要改善經絡體質，就是要服用一些熱性的中藥或食物，經常疏通相關的經絡。

至少要經常拍打脾經、膽經、胃經與腎經。每日按揉三陰交、太衝、血海等穴，沿帶脈環腰輕輕推揉腹部。

已經罹患子宮肌瘤的人，在情緒上要經常疏解壓力，避免鬱怒，可練習靜坐、太極、瑜伽。

飲食原則忌生冷、油膩、甜食，避免加重痰濕。適當食用活血散結食材：山楂、黑木耳、醋、玫瑰花茶。腎虛者可適量食用黑豆、桑葚、核桃。

平時一定要注意保暖防寒，尤其注意小腹、腰骶部保暖，避免寒凝血瘀。不要穿露肚裝，也不要穿短裙短褲，加重膽經、胃經與腎經的虛證，加重疾病治癒的困難性。
records.etiology_en:
Uterine fibroids have certainly troubled women for thousands of years, though ancient Chinese medicine had no term for "fibroid" as such — the corresponding term was "zheng jia" (concretions and conglomerations), referring to masses arising within the female pelvic reproductive organs.

The ancients termed a mass arising in the uterus "shi jia" (stone conglomeration) and one arising in the uterine vessels "chang tan" (intestinal mass). The Chinese medicine view of uterine fibroids is of a dynamic process progressing from "qi stagnation" to "blood stasis" to "intermingled phlegm and stasis," rooted in disharmony of liver, spleen, and kidney function.

Treatment is not simply about eliminating a "mass of flesh," but about restoring the normal metabolism of qi, blood, and fluids throughout the body — by soothing the liver and resolving stagnation, strengthening the spleen and resolving dampness, and tonifying the kidney and replenishing essence — so as to harmonize the chong and ren vessels and cleanse the uterus. The main TCM patterns are as follows:

1. Liver qi stagnation: the starting point of qi obstruction

The liver governs free coursing and favors an unconstrained, smoothly flowing state, regulating qi movement and emotions throughout the body. Prolonged stress, depressed mood, or anger that is not released most readily leads to liver qi stagnation. Qi is the commander of blood — where qi moves, blood moves; when qi stagnates, blood flow becomes impaired and blood stasis gradually forms.

More critically, the pathway of the foot jueyin liver channel, as described in the Huang Di Nei Jing · Ling Shu (Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic, Spiritual Pivot): "...follows the medial thigh, enters the pubic hair, passes the genitals, and reaches the lower abdomen..." — running directly around the genitals to the lower abdomen, where the uterus is located.

In people with liver qi stagnation, the liver channel's course to the lower abdomen can give rise to uterine disease

Therefore, stagnation of qi and blood in the liver channel directly affects the circulation of qi and blood in the uterus. When blood stasis persists and accumulates within the uterine wall, it becomes the material basis for fibroid formation — hence the saying, "fibroids begin with liver stagnation and form through blood stasis."

2. Spleen deficiency with dampness accumulation: the soil from which phlegm-turbidity forms

The spleen governs transportation and transformation, responsible for digesting food and drink and moving water and dampness. Unregulated eating habits common today (a preference for raw, cold, greasy, or sweet foods), excessive worry, or overexertion can all damage spleen qi and lead to spleen deficiency.

When the spleen is deficient, its function of moving water and dampness weakens; excess fluid in the body cannot be metabolized normally and instead condenses into damp turbidity, which further concentrates into phlegm turbidity. This phlegm-damp is a sticky, turbid pathological product that readily pours downward into the uterus.

When this phlegm-turbidity intertwines with the blood stasis produced by liver stagnation described above, it forms the more stubborn pattern of "intermingled phlegm and stasis," causing fibroids to gradually enlarge and potentially become firmer in texture.

3. Kidney qi deficiency: the key factor undermining the root

The kidney is the root of congenital constitution, storing essence and governing reproduction, and is the source of the chong and ren vessels. Kidney qi deficiency, particularly kidney yang insufficiency, is like the uterus being deprived of warming sunlight, giving rise to internal deficiency-cold. The contracting, congealing nature of cold slows blood flow further, aggravating the pattern of "cold congealing and blood stasis."

On the other hand, kidney yin insufficiency produces yin deficiency with internal heat; deficiency fire continually scorches the blood, thickening it and leading to "deficiency heat scorching the blood into stasis."

Kidney deficiency deprives the body of its fundamental capacity for repair and balance, making blood stasis harder to resolve and fibroids more prone to recur.

People with kidney yang insufficiency are prone to uterine disease

4. Meridian yang deficiency: the stable underlying constitution

Analysis of extensive modern meridian data reveals a crucial but often overlooked type: deficiency of the gallbladder, stomach, and kidney channels caused by "cold and yang deficiency," which represents a deep-seated, fundamental mechanism in the formation of uterine fibroids.

This not only explains why many patients also present with systemic cold-deficiency symptoms, but also points treatment toward the broad direction of "warming yang and unblocking the channels."

The Huang Di Nei Jing states: "Yang transforms into qi; yin forms substance." As a tangible product of "yin excess," uterine fibroids grow in an environment fundamentally shaped, in part, by insufficient warming and qi-transformation function of the body's "yang qi."

When the body's yang qi (centered above all on kidney yang) weakens, yin-cold arises internally or invades from outside, causing blood and body fluids to congeal upon encountering cold — solidifying from a "gaseous" or "liquid" state into a "solid" state as blood stasis and phlegm-fluid.

This cold invades and lodges in the uterus along specific meridian pathways. Among these, the foot shaoyang gallbladder channel, foot yangming stomach channel, and foot shaoyin kidney channel all run to the lower abdomen; because their pathways and physiological functions are directly connected to the uterus, they become the key routes by which cold pathogens invade.

Chinese medicine holds that "the kidney governs reproduction" and "the uterine network connects to the kidney." The kidney channel, via the chong and ren vessels, is closely linked to the uterus, supplying it with fundamental original yang and original yin.

Kidney yang is the root of yang qi throughout the body, like the fire beneath a pot. When kidney yang is insufficient (a decline of the life-gate fire), it fails to warm the lower burner and uterus, resulting in uterine cold. The congealing nature of cold prevents menstrual blood from flowing out smoothly, which over time forms stasis.

Kidney yang deficiency that fails to warm spleen yang ("fire fails to generate earth") worsens spleen deficiency with dampness accumulation, forming cold-damp. Yang deficiency also fails to secure the belt (dai) vessel, causing it to slacken; kidney yang deficiency weakens the belt vessel's restraining function, making it easier for damp turbidity in the lower burner to pour down into the uterus.

The meridian pattern commonly seen in uterine fibroids

Extensive modern meridian data show a very high degree of correlation among deficiency patterns in the gallbladder, kidney, and stomach channels. In particular, the main trunk of the stomach channel runs straight down the abdomen, directly in front of the uterus, giving it a direct anterior relationship with the uterus.

The belt vessel is especially related to the gallbladder channel — it encircles the waist and restrains the longitudinally running channels. Spleen deficiency with dampness excess, or liver stagnation overacting on the spleen, can cause the belt vessel to slacken, allowing water-dampness to pour down into the uterus and aggravating phlegm-stasis.

Chinese medicine holds that "a woman's menstruation, pregnancy, childbirth, and lactation all depend on blood." The kidney channel is related to the chong vessel, which functions as the "sea of blood"; the ren vessel governs the fetus, and both the chong and ren vessels originate from the uterus. When qi and blood in the chong and ren vessels become disordered, the filling and discharge of the sea of blood becomes abnormal, readily causing blood stasis and phlegm-damp to linger in the uterus.

So from the perspective of meridian constitution, when a person has long-standing uterine fibroids that are difficult to resolve, the key factor is a result produced by the phenomenon of a "cold, yang-deficient meridian constitution."

The cold-deficiency of these three channels does not exist in isolation, but forms a mutually reinforcing cycle of deterioration:

Starting point: congenital insufficiency or acquired depletion (excessive consumption of raw, cold foods, staying up late, overexertion) leads to kidney yang decline (the root).

Effect one: kidney yang deficiency fails to warm spleen and stomach yang, resulting in stomach channel cold-deficiency (the source and pathway of qi and blood) — qi and blood generation becomes insufficient and the downward pathway is impaired.

Effect two: kidney yang deficiency together with stomach yang deficiency weakens yang qi throughout the body, leaving the gallbladder channel's shaoyang "spring-germinating" qi unable to rise (the pivot fails), and qi movement stagnates along the lateral aspect.

The three key channels that supply the uterus with qi, blood, and warmth, and are responsible for clearing its metabolic waste (anterior, lateral, and root), fall simultaneously into a state of "deficiency-cold."

As a result, cold, blood stasis, and phlegm-damp most readily congeal and accumulate in this "low-temperature" soil (the uterus), and are difficult for the body's yang qi to disperse — ultimately hardening stubbornly into a fibroid.

Uterine fibroids are an organic (structural) pathology. If one hopes for a therapy that makes the mass disappear instantly, the simplest option is to seek Western medical treatment.

The principle behind Chinese medicine's approach to improvement is to adjust the "internal environment" so that fibroids lose the conditions needed to grow, allowing them to gradually and naturally regress, or to speed up improvement when combined with Western medical treatment.

The core method behind Chinese medicine's approach to uterine fibroids is "invigorating the blood and resolving stasis." Since the underlying constitution is known to be predominantly cold, improving the meridian constitution requires taking warming herbs or foods and regularly unblocking the relevant channels.

At minimum, the spleen, gallbladder, stomach, and kidney channels should be regularly tapped. Daily massage of points such as Sanyinjiao (SP6), Taichong (LR3), and Xuehai (SP10) is recommended, along with gently kneading the abdomen along the path of the belt vessel around the waist.

Those already diagnosed with uterine fibroids should regularly relieve emotional stress and avoid suppressed anger; practices such as meditation, tai chi, and yoga can help.

Dietary principles call for avoiding raw, cold, greasy, and sweet foods to prevent aggravating phlegm-damp. Foods that invigorate blood and disperse masses may be appropriately included, such as hawthorn, black fungus, vinegar, and rose tea. Those with kidney deficiency may moderately consume black beans, mulberries, and walnuts.

It is essential to keep warm and guard against cold at all times, paying particular attention to keeping the lower abdomen and lumbosacral region warm, to avoid cold congealing into blood stasis. Avoid wearing midriff-baring clothing, short skirts, or shorts, as these can aggravate deficiency in the gallbladder, stomach, and kidney channels and make the condition more difficult to resolve.
records.western_pathology_zh:
子宮肌瘤是女性生殖系統中最常見的良性腫瘤，由子宮平滑肌細胞過度增生形成，幾乎 30% 以上的婦女在一生中會患有子宮肌瘤。它是婦女最常見的一種良性婦科腫瘤，好發年齡 35~45 歲間。

雖為良性，但其大小、位置與數量不同，對女性的經期、生活品質與生育能力可能產生不同影響。

從現代醫學角度來看，子宮肌瘤的成因並非單一因素，而是由女性荷爾蒙、基因與生活型態共同影響。

大多數肌瘤無症狀，但若症狀出現，常見包括經血過多、經期延長、骨盆壓迫感、頻尿、便秘、下腹脹感，或因貧血導致疲倦。此外，某些肌瘤會影響胚胎著床與懷孕過程。

多數的時候，若有經血過多或疼痛，可透過藥物控制症狀，子宮肌瘤剔除術是常見的手術，包括腹腔鏡或子宮鏡的微創手術。若無生育需求且症狀嚴重，子宮切除術則能根治。

許多女性長期受到此疾病困擾，卻不想移除子宮，這時候可以從中醫經絡的角度來思考，提供不同的思路。
records.western_pathology_en:
Uterine fibroids are the most common benign tumor of the female reproductive system, formed by excessive proliferation of uterine smooth muscle cells; nearly 30% or more of women will develop uterine fibroids at some point in their lives. They are the most common benign gynecological tumor in women, with peak incidence between ages 35 and 45.

Although benign, their size, location, and number can have varying effects on a woman's menstrual periods, quality of life, and fertility.

From a modern medical perspective, uterine fibroids do not have a single cause, but arise from the combined influence of female hormones, genetics, and lifestyle.

Most fibroids are asymptomatic, but when symptoms do occur they commonly include heavy menstrual bleeding, prolonged periods, pelvic pressure, frequent urination, constipation, lower abdominal distension, or fatigue due to anemia. In addition, certain fibroids can affect embryo implantation and the course of pregnancy.

In most cases, heavy bleeding or pain can be managed with medication. Myomectomy is a common surgical option, including minimally invasive laparoscopic or hysteroscopic approaches. If there is no desire for future fertility and symptoms are severe, hysterectomy offers a definitive cure.

Many women are troubled by this condition long-term but do not wish to have their uterus removed. In such cases, considering the condition from the perspective of Chinese medicine's channels can offer an alternative way of thinking about treatment.
herb_formulas: 當歸四逆加吳茱萸生薑湯
records.classical_references_zh: 《醫宗金鑒婦科心法要訣．癥瘕積痞痎癖疝諸證》："凡治諸癥積，宜先審身形之壯弱、病勢之緩急而治之。如人虛，則氣血衰弱，不任攻伐，病勢雖盛，當先扶正，而後治其病;若形證俱實，宜先攻其病也。經云："大積大聚，衰其大半而止，蓋恐過於攻伐，傷其氣血也。"

records.summary_zh: 原發性痛經指無骨盆腔器質病變的經期疼痛，多因前列腺素引起子宮過度收縮，常於初經後 1–2 年開始，疼痛集中於下腹並可放射至腰背與大腿。
records.summary_en: Primary dysmenorrhea is menstrual pain without pelvic pathology, largely from prostaglandin-mediated uterine hypercontractility. It typically begins within 1–2 years of menarche, with cramping lower-abdominal pain that may radiate to the back and thighs.
red_flags_zh: 疼痛型態改變或成年後才新發之痛經應排除次發性病因（如內膜異位）
發燒、異常分泌物提示骨盆腔感染
疑似懷孕合併劇痛需排除異位妊娠
止痛無效且進行性加重需進一步影像評估
red_flags_en: Change in pain pattern or new-onset dysmenorrhea in adulthood — rule out secondary causes (e.g., endometriosis)
Fever or abnormal discharge suggests pelvic infection
Possible pregnancy with severe pain — rule out ectopic pregnancy
Pain unresponsive to analgesia and progressively worsening — pursue imaging
records.western_context_zh: 常以非類固醇消炎止痛藥、複方避孕藥與局部熱敷處理；此為文件對照用語，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with NSAIDs, combined oral contraceptives, and local heat. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.
records.etiology_zh:
月經不調，也稱為月經失調，這絕對是困擾中國人千年以上的症狀，可以說中醫婦科有一大半都是在調經。

月經不調範圍很大，主要是指月經沒有一定規律，或先或後，也被稱為「經行先後無定期」，亦稱「月經紊亂」。

傳統中醫認為，造成月經失調的原因很多，例如：先天體質偏寒偏熱、壓力太大、過度勞累熬夜、飲食不當或藥物影響等，都可能使肝、脾、腎臟腑功能失常及氣血失調，而導致月經異常。

造成月經失調的中醫證候也很多，例如：氣虛、血虛、腎虛、體內陰寒、氣滯血瘀或痰濕、血熱、陰虛火旺...等等，這都有可能造成月經不調。

雲端中醫常常有一些讀者寫信來說，他們很喜歡中醫，但是總覺得中醫很難理解，像這樣複雜的月經不調原因，究竟該如何學習呢？

其實，學中醫的目的如果是要醫治成千上萬個病患，那確實是非常困難，但是如果只是要改善「自己」或「家人」的月經不調，那是簡單到不行。只要直接幫自己或家人進行經絡檢測，觀察經絡數值與型態，清楚不過的數據圖表就直接給你答案！

以下從經絡數據的角度，結合探討傳統中醫月經不調的證候，歸納出主要幾種原因：

1. 月經不調基本模型(肝、脾、腎不調)

由於月經不調的女性實在太多了，因此雲端中醫資料庫裡相關的經絡數據也非常多，要找出月經不調的最原始模型，最好的方法是找一位年輕、無病卻月經失調的女性來檢測，就可以看出月經不調最原始的樣貌。

從某會員的19歲女兒，她從第一次月經到現在已經第5年，以前都是正常的，在施打第一劑新冠疫苗之前，月經就開始延後約1-2個星期，在施打疫苗第1劑之後就更加明顯了，經常超過兩個月以上月經還不來。

在2022年7月底時，她已經打了第3劑新冠疫苗，距離上一次月經已經超過70天，當天的經絡型態如下圖：

19歲女性距離上次月經超過70天

只要經常閱讀雲端中醫文章的讀者都會知道，這就是典型的「鐵三角」經絡型態。這種經絡型態肝經實證、脾經與膀胱經虛證，最容易出現各種「肝脾不調」的症狀，這很有可能就是「月經不調」的最核心基本模型。

這位會員說：「女兒每天都很晚睡，每天深夜還在玩手遊，上一次月經也是去醫院打針才來的，讓我很頭痛！」「她的手遊朋友也一樣，每天都深夜3點睡，月經已經超過3個月沒來了！」

然而，這只是一位19歲女性的月經不調經絡型態，20-45歲之間的型態又是如何呢？從大量現代女性的經絡數據中發現，不少月經不調的女性，都是以「鐵三角」為基礎來產生的變化型，最常出現下圖的經絡型態：

20-45歲之間容易出現月經不調經絡型態

從上圖可以看到，這還加上了腎經虛證，尤其是20歲以上的女性很容易出現，這可以說更是畫龍點睛。肝經實證，加上脾經、腎經與膀胱經虛證，形成完美的鐵三角經絡型態，這可以說就是月經不調的最基本模型。

這一種經絡型態，可以用來解釋傳統中醫所說的脾虛、腎虛、肝脾不調、血虛、氣血兩虛、氣滯血瘀或痰濕...等等所造成的月經不調。這麼多的中醫證候，背後的經絡圖卻幾乎是一樣的，這不是很簡單嗎？

當然，這句話是寫給已經閱讀過很多雲端中醫文章的讀者，如果還不能理解的人，請先閱讀其他相關文章。[@ad:1]

2. 血熱，陰虛化熱

上面提到月經延後，現在要探討月經提前、過多，甚至月經不止(崩漏)。傳統中醫認為，月經提前或量多常是血熱、血瘀、虛熱、脾虛或濕熱所造成，其中「血熱」為多，所以這理要探討所謂的「熱」。

大家可以仔細看看上面最多人出現月經不調的經絡型態，上面的三焦經與大腸經是實證的。這種鐵三角經絡型態只要長期保持在體內，有一天就會化熱，也可以說是一種「陰虛火旺」現象，這時候就容易出現月經提前或不止。

鐵三角經絡型態容易化熱

這裡提出一個真實案例，在2020年時，有一位49歲女性月經不止長達半年以上，斷斷續續時有時無，總是不會乾淨。那段期間她經常幫自己進行經絡檢測，總是出現脾經與膀胱經能量嚴重低下現象，分享其中一張經絡圖如下：

2020年月經不止長達半年以上

這張經絡圖上全身體能數值72，她的脾經竟然只有20上下，膀胱經更是低於20。同時三焦經與大腸經能量始終居高不下。直到2021年的時候她說：「月經終於從我的生命中消失了，因為進入更慘的階段！」

所謂的更慘階段，是因為她開始進入更年期，陸續出現更多症狀(夜間失眠、潮熱、盜汗、很容易生氣...等等)，所以這種經絡型態正無縫接軌成為「更年期症候群」。

所以只要理解這種經絡型態，除了可以理解月經不調的背後原因，更可以串連至「更年期症候群」，還有更多的疾病(乳癌、肺癌、大腸癌...等等)，學中醫開始是不是變得很簡單呢？

基於此，更可以推斷所謂的「鐵三角經絡型態」，應該就是直接影響人體的內分泌、免疫系統！

3. 體內陰寒，陽虛經絡型態

中醫常說：「十個女人九個虛寒！」既然如此，為什麼到現在為止，都沒有討論寒氣這件事呢？原因很簡單，因為這篇文章第一版是寫在夏季，這時候多數人體內是看不到陽虛經絡型態的。

再度回到本文最先提到的19歲女性案例，她在2022年冬天施打疫苗之後，就已經開始出現月經延遲現象，當時她體內的經絡現象呈現嚴重陽虛(體內陽經沒有能量)，完全與2022年夏天的經絡型態完全不一樣。

19歲月經延遲女性，在冬天時的經絡型態

因此可以說，造成這位女性月經不調的真正核心經絡現象，很有可能源自於體內深深的寒氣陽虛現象，而不是所謂的鐵三角經絡型態。

而重點來了：不少人在施打完新冠疫苗之後，都出現這種陽虛經絡型態，疫苗很有可能加深體內陽虛經絡現象，而體內寒氣不嚴重的人到了夏天就會自動消失！

就一般「亞健康狀態」的人而言，冬天會出現冬天的經絡型態，夏天會出現夏天的經絡型態，一年四季循環變化著。而真正健康的人，是一年四季都出現「平和經絡型態」(沒有異常經絡)。

由於她是年輕人，還不會出現固定的經絡體質現象，體內的寒氣在夏天時被隱藏住了，再加上整個夏天熬夜玩手遊，才出現夏天典型的鐵三角經絡型態。

讀到現在，各位讀者有沒有覺得被騙的感覺？究竟哪一種經絡型態才是造成月經不調的經絡型態呢？

其實雲端中醫沒有騙大家，因為這只是一位19歲年輕人的經絡模型，多數月經不調的女性數據都是在30歲以上，他們的經絡型態幾乎都是穩定呈現鐵三角＋陽虛，也就是下圖這種經絡型態：

35歲以上經常出現的綜合經絡型態

所以只要這位19歲女性繼續喝冰水、每天熬夜玩手遊，在30歲之後就會開始形成這種經絡體質，在50歲的時候出現更年期症候群，這完全就是可以被預測的。

只要家裡有一套經絡檢測系統的女性，在月經期間很容易出現這篇文章所提到的經絡型態，有些女性在月經期間感到寒冷、偏頭痛、頭暈、腰酸背痛...等等，其實都是冬季常見的膽經、胃經與腎經虛證所造成，這都可以親身驗證。

4. 氣血兩虛、胸腹經絡不通

傳統中醫認為，氣血虧虛的女性，最容易出現月經不調，從經絡怎麼看氣血虧虛呢？最直接的就是整體性的經絡數值(體能數值)，愈高代表氣血旺盛，愈低代表氣血不足。

月經延後的女性，多數體能數值較低。在炎熱夏天裡會偏低，在寒冷冬天裡會更低，這也就是驗證體內氣血虧虛最簡單方法。

然而，如果而一位女性如果體能數值很高，有沒有可能還是氣血虧虛呢？這是非常有可能的，如果一位女性的「脾經虛證」久了，由於脾是生血之源，自然也會出現氣血虧虛。

也是因為如此，氣血虧虛只是一種結果，而不是原因，真正的原因還是要從經絡型態來加以辨別探討。而有一種經絡型態也會出現月經不調，那就是神秘的「上虛下實」經絡型態。

2022年6月時就有一位女性會員分享，她的月經大約延後了2個星期，月經出現的第一天突然間像感冒一樣打噴嚏、狂流鼻水，鼻子感到很癢，當天的經絡型態呈現下圖：

上虛下實的經絡型態也有可能出現月經延後

由於她經常出現上虛下實的經絡型態，所以這可以說算是一種體質現象。這種經絡型態主要是通過胸部、腹部的經絡嚴重阻塞，在多數的時候也是體內陰寒所造成，可以參考這篇文章(點選開啟)。

改善月經不調的方法

不論中醫分析月經不調有多複雜，這篇文章探討的經絡型態卻是單純到不行，只要改善這一種經絡型態，月經不調就會自然消失，學中醫養生就會非常簡單！然而，問題就在於這種經絡型態很難改變。

再度回到上面提到的19歲女性，在父母的強烈要求下，逼她連續兩天晚上11點上床睡覺，不要玩手遊，第三天幫她進行經絡檢測，結果竟然出現「最佳養生典範」標章。女兒笑說：「這套經絡檢測系統，跟遊戲一樣好玩耶！」

連續兩天晚上11點入睡，不玩手遊

可惜的是，這位會員只有高興一天，因為這位19歲女性在連續兩天早睡之後，覺得自己精神奕奕，有實力晚睡，第三天之後開始深夜2點才睡。這位會員搖頭說：「看來這真是沒救了！」

在過去十年以上的時間裡，有為數眾多的會員親身驗證，只要是熬夜晚睡、壓力大時，就會出現這種鐵三角經絡型態，這是不分季節的。所以只要反過來說，早睡、放鬆、釋放內心壓力，就是改善月經不調的根本方法，運用經絡檢測可以反覆驗證。

由於經絡圖上會顯示異常經絡，只要哪一條經絡異常，就去拍打、按摩、刮痧、拔罐相關穴道，可以從本文的3D穴道頁面清楚查看，最常見的就是肝經、脾經、腎經與膀胱經4條經絡異常。

體內寒氣深重的女性，除了少喝冰水，吃寒涼食物外，可以配合熱性中藥，相關的中藥在本文中有提出，也可以找中醫師配合討論。

月經不調是女性常見的症狀，相關的經絡型態也常見，每一位女性一輩子都有可能遇到，因此本篇文章的內容學習起來，可以運用一輩子可以說是非常划算的！
records.western_pathology_zh:
月經失調是一種女性常見的困擾，但這不是一種疾病，而是女性月經週期、經期長度或出血量出現異常症狀的統稱。

現代醫學發現，女性正常的月經週期約為24-38天，每次經期約4-8天，而一次月經週期的出血量大約是35ml，通常不會超過80ml。

月經週期不規則，一般是身體內分泌的異常所造成，這是一個由腦部到卵巢、子宮內膜的複雜調控機制，主要調控的中樞為下視丘、腦下垂體與卵巢。

正常狀況下，女性第一次月經後的2年期間，月經容易出現不規則，這是正常的生理現象。2年後，女性如果太久月經沒來、月經持續時間太長等問題，就是月經不規則。

月經不規則的原因很多，例如：疾病、藥物(消炎藥、抗生素)、吸菸、熬夜、壓力、情緒、體重改變（比如過度減肥）、過度運動等。

一些疾病如腦下垂體腺瘤，卵巢疾病如「多囊性卵巢症候群」、子宮疾病(子宮內膜息肉、子宮腺肌症、子宮肌瘤)造成不正常出血...等等都會造成月經失調。

中醫婦科可以說是中醫的強項，有千年以上的歷史經驗，而其中一大半就是在改善月經不調，亞洲女性有不少人在出現月經不調時會尋找中醫治療，所以這是一個非常值得參考的醫療選項。

symptoms_zh: 腹部腫大但軀體四肢消瘦

records.classical_references_zh: 《景岳全書.婦人規》：「凡欲念不遂，沉思積鬱，心脾氣結致傷衝任之源，而腎氣日消，輕則或早或遲，重則漸成枯閉，此宜兼治心脾腎。」

records.summary_zh: 經前症候群指黃體期反覆出現、月經來潮後緩解的身心症狀（如乳房脹痛、腹脹、易怒、情緒低落、疲倦），症狀須與月經週期有明確時間關聯並影響生活功能。
records.summary_en: Premenstrual syndrome is a cyclical cluster of physical and mood symptoms (breast tenderness, bloating, irritability, low mood, fatigue) in the luteal phase that resolve after menses, with a clear temporal link to the cycle and functional impact.
red_flags_zh: 嚴重情緒低落、絕望或自殺意念需即時心理／精神科評估
症狀無週期性或持續整月，應重新評估診斷
症狀急遽惡化影響安全或工作能力
red_flags_en: Severe low mood, hopelessness, or suicidal ideation — urgent mental-health evaluation
Non-cyclical or month-long symptoms — reconsider the diagnosis
Rapid worsening affecting safety or function
records.western_context_zh: 常以生活型態與飲食調整、運動，必要時選用血清素類藥物或荷爾蒙處置；此為文件對照用語，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with lifestyle and dietary measures, exercise, and where needed serotonergic agents or hormonal approaches. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

這位會員說：「女兒每天都很晚睡，每天深夜還在玩手遊，上一次月經也是去醫院打針才來的，讓我很頭痛！」「她的手遊朋友也一樣，每天都深夜3點睡，月經已經超過3個月沒來了！」

然而，這只是一位19歲女性的月經不調經絡型態，20-45歲之間的型態又是如何呢？從大量現代女性的經絡數據中發現，不少月經不調的女性，都是以「鐵三角」為基礎來產生的變化型，最常出現下圖的經絡型態：

20-45歲之間容易出現月經不調經絡型態

從上圖可以看到，這還加上了腎經虛證，尤其是20歲以上的女性很容易出現，這可以說更是畫龍點睛。肝經實證，加上脾經、腎經與膀胱經虛證，形成完美的鐵三角經絡型態，這可以說就是月經不調的最基本模型。

這一種經絡型態，可以用來解釋傳統中醫所說的脾虛、腎虛、肝脾不調、血虛、氣血兩虛、氣滯血瘀或痰濕...等等所造成的月經不調。這麼多的中醫證候，背後的經絡圖卻幾乎是一樣的，這不是很簡單嗎？

當然，這句話是寫給已經閱讀過很多雲端中醫文章的讀者，如果還不能理解的人，請先閱讀其他相關文章。[@ad:1]

2. 血熱，陰虛化熱

上面提到月經延後，現在要探討月經提前、過多，甚至月經不止(崩漏)。傳統中醫認為，月經提前或量多常是血熱、血瘀、虛熱、脾虛或濕熱所造成，其中「血熱」為多，所以這理要探討所謂的「熱」。

大家可以仔細看看上面最多人出現月經不調的經絡型態，上面的三焦經與大腸經是實證的。這種鐵三角經絡型態只要長期保持在體內，有一天就會化熱，也可以說是一種「陰虛火旺」現象，這時候就容易出現月經提前或不止。

鐵三角經絡型態容易化熱

這裡提出一個真實案例，在2020年時，有一位49歲女性月經不止長達半年以上，斷斷續續時有時無，總是不會乾淨。那段期間她經常幫自己進行經絡檢測，總是出現脾經與膀胱經能量嚴重低下現象，分享其中一張經絡圖如下：

2020年月經不止長達半年以上

這張經絡圖上全身體能數值72，她的脾經竟然只有20上下，膀胱經更是低於20。同時三焦經與大腸經能量始終居高不下。直到2021年的時候她說：「月經終於從我的生命中消失了，因為進入更慘的階段！」

所謂的更慘階段，是因為她開始進入更年期，陸續出現更多症狀(夜間失眠、潮熱、盜汗、很容易生氣...等等)，所以這種經絡型態正無縫接軌成為「更年期症候群」。

所以只要理解這種經絡型態，除了可以理解月經不調的背後原因，更可以串連至「更年期症候群」，還有更多的疾病(乳癌、肺癌、大腸癌...等等)，學中醫開始是不是變得很簡單呢？

基於此，更可以推斷所謂的「鐵三角經絡型態」，應該就是直接影響人體的內分泌、免疫系統！

3. 體內陰寒，陽虛經絡型態

中醫常說：「十個女人九個虛寒！」既然如此，為什麼到現在為止，都沒有討論寒氣這件事呢？原因很簡單，因為這篇文章第一版是寫在夏季，這時候多數人體內是看不到陽虛經絡型態的。

再度回到本文最先提到的19歲女性案例，她在2022年冬天施打疫苗之後，就已經開始出現月經延遲現象，當時她體內的經絡現象呈現嚴重陽虛(體內陽經沒有能量)，完全與2022年夏天的經絡型態完全不一樣。

19歲月經延遲女性，在冬天時的經絡型態

因此可以說，造成這位女性月經不調的真正核心經絡現象，很有可能源自於體內深深的寒氣陽虛現象，而不是所謂的鐵三角經絡型態。

而重點來了：不少人在施打完新冠疫苗之後，都出現這種陽虛經絡型態，疫苗很有可能加深體內陽虛經絡現象，而體內寒氣不嚴重的人到了夏天就會自動消失！

就一般「亞健康狀態」的人而言，冬天會出現冬天的經絡型態，夏天會出現夏天的經絡型態，一年四季循環變化著。而真正健康的人，是一年四季都出現「平和經絡型態」(沒有異常經絡)。

由於她是年輕人，還不會出現固定的經絡體質現象，體內的寒氣在夏天時被隱藏住了，再加上整個夏天熬夜玩手遊，才出現夏天典型的鐵三角經絡型態。

讀到現在，各位讀者有沒有覺得被騙的感覺？究竟哪一種經絡型態才是造成月經不調的經絡型態呢？

其實雲端中醫沒有騙大家，因為這只是一位19歲年輕人的經絡模型，多數月經不調的女性數據都是在30歲以上，他們的經絡型態幾乎都是穩定呈現鐵三角＋陽虛，也就是下圖這種經絡型態：

35歲以上經常出現的綜合經絡型態

所以只要這位19歲女性繼續喝冰水、每天熬夜玩手遊，在30歲之後就會開始形成這種經絡體質，在50歲的時候出現更年期症候群，這完全就是可以被預測的。

只要家裡有一套經絡檢測系統的女性，在月經期間很容易出現這篇文章所提到的經絡型態，有些女性在月經期間感到寒冷、偏頭痛、頭暈、腰酸背痛...等等，其實都是冬季常見的膽經、胃經與腎經虛證所造成，這都可以親身驗證。

4. 氣血兩虛、胸腹經絡不通

傳統中醫認為，氣血虧虛的女性，最容易出現月經不調，從經絡怎麼看氣血虧虛呢？最直接的就是整體性的經絡數值(體能數值)，愈高代表氣血旺盛，愈低代表氣血不足。

月經延後的女性，多數體能數值較低。在炎熱夏天裡會偏低，在寒冷冬天裡會更低，這也就是驗證體內氣血虧虛最簡單方法。

然而，如果而一位女性如果體能數值很高，有沒有可能還是氣血虧虛呢？這是非常有可能的，如果一位女性的「脾經虛證」久了，由於脾是生血之源，自然也會出現氣血虧虛。

也是因為如此，氣血虧虛只是一種結果，而不是原因，真正的原因還是要從經絡型態來加以辨別探討。而有一種經絡型態也會出現月經不調，那就是神秘的「上虛下實」經絡型態。

2022年6月時就有一位女性會員分享，她的月經大約延後了2個星期，月經出現的第一天突然間像感冒一樣打噴嚏、狂流鼻水，鼻子感到很癢，當天的經絡型態呈現下圖：

上虛下實的經絡型態也有可能出現月經延後

由於她經常出現上虛下實的經絡型態，所以這可以說算是一種體質現象。這種經絡型態主要是通過胸部、腹部的經絡嚴重阻塞，在多數的時候也是體內陰寒所造成，可以參考這篇文章(點選開啟)。

改善月經不調的方法

不論中醫分析月經不調有多複雜，這篇文章探討的經絡型態卻是單純到不行，只要改善這一種經絡型態，月經不調就會自然消失，學中醫養生就會非常簡單！然而，問題就在於這種經絡型態很難改變。

再度回到上面提到的19歲女性，在父母的強烈要求下，逼她連續兩天晚上11點上床睡覺，不要玩手遊，第三天幫她進行經絡檢測，結果竟然出現「最佳養生典範」標章。女兒笑說：「這套經絡檢測系統，跟遊戲一樣好玩耶！」

連續兩天晚上11點入睡，不玩手遊

可惜的是，這位會員只有高興一天，因為這位19歲女性在連續兩天早睡之後，覺得自己精神奕奕，有實力晚睡，第三天之後開始深夜2點才睡。這位會員搖頭說：「看來這真是沒救了！」

在過去十年以上的時間裡，有為數眾多的會員親身驗證，只要是熬夜晚睡、壓力大時，就會出現這種鐵三角經絡型態，這是不分季節的。所以只要反過來說，早睡、放鬆、釋放內心壓力，就是改善月經不調的根本方法，運用經絡檢測可以反覆驗證。

由於經絡圖上會顯示異常經絡，只要哪一條經絡異常，就去拍打、按摩、刮痧、拔罐相關穴道，可以從本文的3D穴道頁面清楚查看，最常見的就是肝經、脾經、腎經與膀胱經4條經絡異常。

體內寒氣深重的女性，除了少喝冰水，吃寒涼食物外，可以配合熱性中藥，相關的中藥在本文中有提出，也可以找中醫師配合討論。

月經不調是女性常見的症狀，相關的經絡型態也常見，每一位女性一輩子都有可能遇到，因此本篇文章的內容學習起來，可以運用一輩子可以說是非常划算的！
records.western_pathology_zh:
月經失調是一種女性常見的困擾，但這不是一種疾病，而是女性月經週期、經期長度或出血量出現異常症狀的統稱。

現代醫學發現，女性正常的月經週期約為24-38天，每次經期約4-8天，而一次月經週期的出血量大約是35ml，通常不會超過80ml。

月經週期不規則，一般是身體內分泌的異常所造成，這是一個由腦部到卵巢、子宮內膜的複雜調控機制，主要調控的中樞為下視丘、腦下垂體與卵巢。

正常狀況下，女性第一次月經後的2年期間，月經容易出現不規則，這是正常的生理現象。2年後，女性如果太久月經沒來、月經持續時間太長等問題，就是月經不規則。

月經不規則的原因很多，例如：疾病、藥物(消炎藥、抗生素)、吸菸、熬夜、壓力、情緒、體重改變（比如過度減肥）、過度運動等。

一些疾病如腦下垂體腺瘤，卵巢疾病如「多囊性卵巢症候群」、子宮疾病(子宮內膜息肉、子宮腺肌症、子宮肌瘤)造成不正常出血...等等都會造成月經失調。

中醫婦科可以說是中醫的強項，有千年以上的歷史經驗，而其中一大半就是在改善月經不調，亞洲女性有不少人在出現月經不調時會尋找中醫治療，所以這是一個非常值得參考的醫療選項。

月經不調，也稱為月經失調，這絕對是困擾中國人千年以上的症狀，可以說中醫婦科有一大半都是在調經。

月經不調範圍很大，主要是指月經沒有一定規律，或先或後，也被稱為「經行先後無定期」，亦稱「月經紊亂」。

傳統中醫認為，造成月經失調的原因很多，例如：先天體質偏寒偏熱、壓力太大、過度勞累熬夜、飲食不當或藥物影響等，都可能使肝、脾、腎臟腑功能失常及氣血失調，而導致月經異常。

造成月經失調的中醫證候也很多，例如：氣虛、血虛、腎虛、體內陰寒、氣滯血瘀或痰濕、血熱、陰虛火旺...等等，這都有可能造成月經不調。

其實，學中醫的目的如果是要醫治成千上萬個病患，那確實是非常困難，但是如果只是要改善「自己」或「家人」的月經不調，那是簡單到不行。只要直接幫自己或家人進行經絡檢測，觀察經絡數值與型態，清楚不過的數據圖表就直接給你答案！

這張經絡圖上全身體能數值72，她的脾經竟然只有20上下，膀胱經更是低於20。同時三焦經與大腸經能量始終居高不下。直到2021年的時候她說：「月經終於從我的生命中消失了，因為進入更慘的階段！」

所謂的更慘階段，是因為她開始進入更年期，陸續出現更多症狀(夜間失眠、潮熱、盜汗、很容易生氣...等等)，所以這種經絡型態正無縫接軌成為「更年期症候群」。

所以只要理解這種經絡型態，除了可以理解月經不調的背後原因，更可以串連至「更年期症候群」，還有更多的疾病(乳癌、肺癌、大腸癌...等等)，學中醫開始是不是變得很簡單呢？

基於此，更可以推斷所謂的「鐵三角經絡型態」，應該就是直接影響人體的內分泌、免疫系統！

3. 體內陰寒，陽虛經絡型態

中醫常說：「十個女人九個虛寒！」既然如此，為什麼到現在為止，都沒有討論寒氣這件事呢？原因很簡單，因為這篇文章第一版是寫在夏季，這時候多數人體內是看不到陽虛經絡型態的。

再度回到本文最先提到的19歲女性案例，她在2022年冬天施打疫苗之後，就已經開始出現月經延遲現象，當時她體內的經絡現象呈現嚴重陽虛(體內陽經沒有能量)，完全與2022年夏天的經絡型態完全不一樣。

19歲月經延遲女性，在冬天時的經絡型態

因此可以說，造成這位女性月經不調的真正核心經絡現象，很有可能源自於體內深深的寒氣陽虛現象，而不是所謂的鐵三角經絡型態。

而重點來了：不少人在施打完新冠疫苗之後，都出現這種陽虛經絡型態，疫苗很有可能加深體內陽虛經絡現象，而體內寒氣不嚴重的人到了夏天就會自動消失！

就一般「亞健康狀態」的人而言，冬天會出現冬天的經絡型態，夏天會出現夏天的經絡型態，一年四季循環變化著。而真正健康的人，是一年四季都出現「平和經絡型態」(沒有異常經絡)。

由於她是年輕人，還不會出現固定的經絡體質現象，體內的寒氣在夏天時被隱藏住了，再加上整個夏天熬夜玩手遊，才出現夏天典型的鐵三角經絡型態。

讀到現在，各位讀者有沒有覺得被騙的感覺？究竟哪一種經絡型態才是造成月經不調的經絡型態呢？

其實雲端中醫沒有騙大家，因為這只是一位19歲年輕人的經絡模型，多數月經不調的女性數據都是在30歲以上，他們的經絡型態幾乎都是穩定呈現鐵三角＋陽虛，也就是下圖這種經絡型態：

35歲以上經常出現的綜合經絡型態

所以只要這位19歲女性繼續喝冰水、每天熬夜玩手遊，在30歲之後就會開始形成這種經絡體質，在50歲的時候出現更年期症候群，這完全就是可以被預測的。

只要家裡有一套經絡檢測系統的女性，在月經期間很容易出現這篇文章所提到的經絡型態，有些女性在月經期間感到寒冷、偏頭痛、頭暈、腰酸背痛...等等，其實都是冬季常見的膽經、胃經與腎經虛證所造成，這都可以親身驗證。

4. 氣血兩虛、胸腹經絡不通

傳統中醫認為，氣血虧虛的女性，最容易出現月經不調，從經絡怎麼看氣血虧虛呢？最直接的就是整體性的經絡數值(體能數值)，愈高代表氣血旺盛，愈低代表氣血不足。

月經延後的女性，多數體能數值較低。在炎熱夏天裡會偏低，在寒冷冬天裡會更低，這也就是驗證體內氣血虧虛最簡單方法。

然而，如果而一位女性如果體能數值很高，有沒有可能還是氣血虧虛呢？這是非常有可能的，如果一位女性的「脾經虛證」久了，由於脾是生血之源，自然也會出現氣血虧虛。

也是因為如此，氣血虧虛只是一種結果，而不是原因，真正的原因還是要從經絡型態來加以辨別探討。而有一種經絡型態也會出現月經不調，那就是神秘的「上虛下實」經絡型態。

2022年6月時就有一位女性會員分享，她的月經大約延後了2個星期，月經出現的第一天突然間像感冒一樣打噴嚏、狂流鼻水，鼻子感到很癢，當天的經絡型態呈現下圖：

上虛下實的經絡型態也有可能出現月經延後

由於她經常出現上虛下實的經絡型態，所以這可以說算是一種體質現象。這種經絡型態主要是通過胸部、腹部的經絡嚴重阻塞，在多數的時候也是體內陰寒所造成，可以參考這篇文章(點選開啟)。

改善月經不調的方法

不論中醫分析月經不調有多複雜，這篇文章探討的經絡型態卻是單純到不行，只要改善這一種經絡型態，月經不調就會自然消失，學中醫養生就會非常簡單！然而，問題就在於這種經絡型態很難改變。

再度回到上面提到的19歲女性，在父母的強烈要求下，逼她連續兩天晚上11點上床睡覺，不要玩手遊，第三天幫她進行經絡檢測，結果竟然出現「最佳養生典範」標章。女兒笑說：「這套經絡檢測系統，跟遊戲一樣好玩耶！」

連續兩天晚上11點入睡，不玩手遊

可惜的是，這位會員只有高興一天，因為這位19歲女性在連續兩天早睡之後，覺得自己精神奕奕，有實力晚睡，第三天之後開始深夜2點才睡。這位會員搖頭說：「看來這真是沒救了！」

在過去十年以上的時間裡，有為數眾多的會員親身驗證，只要是熬夜晚睡、壓力大時，就會出現這種鐵三角經絡型態，這是不分季節的。所以只要反過來說，早睡、放鬆、釋放內心壓力，就是改善月經不調的根本方法，運用經絡檢測可以反覆驗證。

由於經絡圖上會顯示異常經絡，只要哪一條經絡異常，就去拍打、按摩、刮痧、拔罐相關穴道，可以從本文的3D穴道頁面清楚查看，最常見的就是肝經、脾經、腎經與膀胱經4條經絡異常。

體內寒氣深重的女性，除了少喝冰水，吃寒涼食物外，可以配合熱性中藥，相關的中藥在本文中有提出，也可以找中醫師配合討論。

月經不調是女性常見的症狀，相關的經絡型態也常見，每一位女性一輩子都有可能遇到，因此本篇文章的內容學習起來，可以運用一輩子可以說是非常划算的！
records.etiology_en:
Irregular menstruation, also called menstrual disorder, is a symptom that has troubled Chinese patients for well over a thousand years — it can be said that a large portion of Chinese gynecology is devoted to regulating menstruation.

Irregular menstruation covers a broad range of presentations, mainly referring to menstruation that lacks a consistent rhythm — arriving early or late — also termed "menstruation with no fixed timing" or "menstrual disorder."

Traditional Chinese medicine holds that there are many causes of menstrual irregularity — a congenitally cold or hot constitution, excessive stress, overexertion and staying up late, improper diet, or medication effects can all disrupt the function of the liver, spleen, and kidney organ systems and disturb qi and blood, leading to menstrual abnormality.

The TCM patterns underlying menstrual irregularity are also numerous — qi deficiency, blood deficiency, kidney deficiency, internal yin-cold, qi stagnation with blood stasis or phlegm-damp, blood heat, and yin deficiency with effulgent fire can all potentially cause irregular menstruation.

Readers often write to CloudTCM saying that while they enjoy Chinese medicine, they find it difficult to understand — with causes of menstrual irregularity this complex, how should one even begin to learn?

In truth, if the goal of studying Chinese medicine is to treat thousands of patients, that is indeed very difficult. But if the goal is simply to help improve menstrual irregularity in oneself or a family member, it can be remarkably simple. By performing meridian measurement on oneself or a family member and observing the resulting values and patterns, the data and charts provide a clear answer directly.

The following discussion combines a meridian-data perspective with traditional Chinese medicine patterns of menstrual irregularity to summarize several main causes:

1. The basic model of menstrual irregularity (liver, spleen, and kidney disharmony)

Because so many women experience menstrual irregularity, the CloudTCM database contains a large amount of related meridian data. To identify the most fundamental model of menstrual irregularity, the best approach is to measure a young woman who is otherwise healthy but has irregular menstruation, which reveals the condition's most basic pattern.

Consider the 19-year-old daughter of one member. It had been five years since her first period, and her cycles had previously been normal. Before receiving her first COVID-19 vaccine dose, her period had already begun arriving about one to two weeks late; after the first dose, this became more pronounced, and her period frequently failed to arrive for more than two months at a time.

By late July 2022, she had received her third COVID-19 vaccine dose, and more than 70 days had passed since her last period. Her meridian pattern that day is shown below:

A 19-year-old woman more than 70 days past her last period

Regular readers of CloudTCM articles will recognize this as the typical "iron triangle" meridian pattern — an excess pattern in the liver channel together with deficiency in the spleen and bladder channels. This pattern most readily produces various symptoms of "liver-spleen disharmony" and is very likely the core, foundational model underlying menstrual irregularity.

This member said: "My daughter stays up late every night playing mobile games until the middle of the night. Last time, her period only came after a hospital injection — it's such a headache!" "Her gaming friend is the same way — she goes to sleep at 3 a.m. every night, and her period hasn't come for over three months!"

However, this is only the meridian pattern of menstrual irregularity in one 19-year-old woman — what does the pattern look like between ages 20 and 45? Analysis of extensive meridian data from modern women shows that many cases of menstrual irregularity are variations built on the "iron triangle" base, most commonly presenting the pattern shown below:

A meridian pattern commonly seen in menstrual irregularity among women aged 20 to 45

As the chart above shows, kidney channel deficiency is also added to the pattern — a feature especially common in women over 20, which really completes the picture. Excess in the liver channel combined with deficiency in the spleen, kidney, and bladder channels forms a complete "iron triangle" meridian pattern, which can be considered the most basic model of menstrual irregularity.

This single meridian pattern can explain the menstrual irregularity attributed in traditional Chinese medicine to spleen deficiency, kidney deficiency, liver-spleen disharmony, blood deficiency, dual deficiency of qi and blood, qi stagnation with blood stasis, or phlegm-damp. Despite the many distinct TCM patterns, the underlying meridian chart is nearly identical each time — isn't that remarkably simple?

Of course, this statement is written for readers who have already read many CloudTCM articles; those who do not yet follow it should first read other related articles. [@ad:1]

2. Blood heat and yin deficiency transforming into heat

The discussion above concerned delayed menstruation; now consider early, excessive, or even unceasing menstruation (beng lou, flooding and spotting). Traditional Chinese medicine holds that early or heavy menstruation is often caused by blood heat, blood stasis, deficiency heat, spleen deficiency, or damp-heat — with "blood heat" being the most common — so this section examines the concept of "heat."

Looking closely at the meridian pattern most commonly seen in menstrual irregularity described above, the triple burner and large intestine channels show excess. If this "iron triangle" pattern persists in the body over the long term, it will eventually transform into heat — a manifestation of "yin deficiency with effulgent fire" — at which point early or unceasing menstruation readily occurs.

The iron-triangle meridian pattern readily transforms into heat

Consider a real case: in 2020, a 49-year-old woman experienced unceasing menstrual bleeding for more than six months, coming and going intermittently and never fully resolving. During that period she frequently performed meridian measurements on herself, which consistently showed severely low energy in the spleen and bladder channels. One of her meridian charts is shown below:

2020 case: menstrual bleeding that continued for over six months

In this meridian chart her overall energy score was 72, yet her spleen channel measured only around 20, and her bladder channel was even lower, under 20. Meanwhile, her triple burner and large intestine channel energy remained persistently high. By 2021, she said: "My period has finally disappeared from my life — because I've entered an even worse stage!"

The "worse stage" she referred to was menopause, which brought a succession of further symptoms — night-time insomnia, hot flashes, night sweats, and irritability, among others. This meridian pattern thus transitions seamlessly into "menopausal syndrome."

So once this meridian pattern is understood, it not only explains the underlying cause of menstrual irregularity, but also connects to "menopausal syndrome" and other conditions (breast cancer, lung cancer, colorectal cancer, and others). Doesn't learning Chinese medicine start to feel much simpler this way?

Based on this, it can further be inferred that the so-called "iron triangle meridian pattern" likely has a direct effect on the body's endocrine and immune systems.

3. Internal yin-cold and the yang-deficient meridian pattern

Chinese medicine has a saying: "Nine out of ten women run cold and deficient!" If so, why has cold not yet been discussed here? The reason is simple: the first version of this article was written in summer, a season in which most people do not show a yang-deficient meridian pattern.

Returning to the 19-year-old case mentioned earlier in this article: after receiving her vaccine in winter 2022, she began to show delayed menstruation. At that time her meridian pattern showed severe yang deficiency (little energy in the yang channels), completely different from her meridian pattern in summer 2022.

The winter meridian pattern of the 19-year-old woman with delayed menstruation

It can therefore be said that the true core meridian phenomenon underlying this woman's menstrual irregularity likely originates from a deep-seated internal cold and yang deficiency, rather than from the so-called iron-triangle pattern.

Here is the key point: many people developed this yang-deficient meridian pattern after receiving the COVID-19 vaccine, suggesting the vaccine may deepen a yang-deficient meridian tendency in the body — though for people without severe internal cold, the pattern tends to resolve on its own by summer.

For people in a general "sub-health" state, winter brings a winter meridian pattern and summer brings a summer meridian pattern, cycling with the seasons throughout the year. In truly healthy people, however, a "balanced meridian pattern" (with no abnormal channels) appears year-round.

Because she is young, a fixed meridian-constitution pattern had not yet set in; her internal cold was masked during summer, and staying up all summer playing mobile games produced the typical summer iron-triangle meridian pattern.

Having read this far, readers may feel somewhat misled — which meridian pattern, then, is actually responsible for menstrual irregularity?

In fact, CloudTCM has not misled anyone — this was only the meridian model of one 19-year-old. Most of the data on women with menstrual irregularity comes from those over 30, whose meridian patterns almost consistently and stably show the iron triangle plus yang deficiency, as illustrated below:

The combined meridian pattern commonly seen in women over 35

So if this 19-year-old continues drinking iced water and staying up late every night playing mobile games, she is likely to develop this meridian constitution after age 30 and experience menopausal syndrome around age 50 — a fully predictable outcome.

Any woman with access to a meridian measurement system at home will readily observe the pattern described in this article during menstruation. Symptoms some women feel during their period — such as feeling cold, migraine, dizziness, and lower back and hip soreness — are in fact often caused by the gallbladder, stomach, and kidney channel deficiencies commonly seen in winter, something that can be personally verified.

For women with deep-seated internal cold, in addition to drinking less iced water and avoiding cold, raw foods, warming herbal formulas can be used in conjunction — relevant formulas are noted in this article — and it is also advisable to discuss options with a Chinese medicine practitioner.

Menstrual irregularity is a common symptom in women, and its associated meridian patterns are equally common — every woman is likely to encounter this at some point in her life. Learning the content of this article is therefore something that can be applied for a lifetime, making it a truly worthwhile investment of time.
records.western_pathology_zh:
月經失調是一種女性常見的困擾，但這不是一種疾病，而是女性月經週期、經期長度或出血量出現異常症狀的統稱。

現代醫學發現，女性正常的月經週期約為24-38天，每次經期約4-8天，而一次月經週期的出血量大約是35ml，通常不會超過80ml。

月經週期不規則，一般是身體內分泌的異常所造成，這是一個由腦部到卵巢、子宮內膜的複雜調控機制，主要調控的中樞為下視丘、腦下垂體與卵巢。

正常狀況下，女性第一次月經後的2年期間，月經容易出現不規則，這是正常的生理現象。2年後，女性如果太久月經沒來、月經持續時間太長等問題，就是月經不規則。

月經不規則的原因很多，例如：疾病、藥物(消炎藥、抗生素)、吸菸、熬夜、壓力、情緒、體重改變（比如過度減肥）、過度運動等。

一些疾病如腦下垂體腺瘤，卵巢疾病如「多囊性卵巢症候群」、子宮疾病(子宮內膜息肉、子宮腺肌症、子宮肌瘤)造成不正常出血...等等都會造成月經失調。

中醫婦科可以說是中醫的強項，有千年以上的歷史經驗，而其中一大半就是在改善月經不調，亞洲女性有不少人在出現月經不調時會尋找中醫治療，所以這是一個非常值得參考的醫療選項。
records.western_pathology_en:
Menstrual irregularity is a common concern for women. It is not itself a disease, but an umbrella term for abnormalities in the menstrual cycle, the length of the period, or the volume of bleeding.

Modern medicine has found that a normal menstrual cycle in women runs approximately 24–38 days, each period lasts about 4–8 days, and total blood loss per cycle is roughly 35 mL, usually not exceeding 80 mL.

Irregular menstrual cycles are generally caused by endocrine abnormalities — a complex regulatory mechanism running from the brain to the ovaries and endometrium, with the hypothalamus, pituitary gland, and ovaries as the main regulatory centers.

Under normal circumstances, menstruation is commonly irregular during the two years following a woman's first period, which is a normal physiological phenomenon. After that two-year period, if menstruation is absent for too long or periods last too long, this is considered menstrual irregularity.

There are many causes of irregular menstruation, including illness, medications (anti-inflammatory drugs, antibiotics), smoking, staying up late, stress, emotional factors, weight changes (such as excessive dieting), and excessive exercise.

Certain conditions — such as pituitary adenoma, ovarian disorders like polycystic ovary syndrome, and uterine conditions (endometrial polyps, adenomyosis, uterine fibroids) causing abnormal bleeding — can also cause menstrual irregularity.

Gynecology is considered one of the strengths of Chinese medicine, with more than a thousand years of clinical experience, much of it devoted to regulating menstruation. Many Asian women turn to Chinese medicine when menstrual irregularity occurs, making it a treatment option well worth considering.

records.summary_en: Heavy menstrual bleeding is markedly increased flow or prolonged menses that may cause iron-deficiency anemia. Causes include ovulatory dysfunction, fibroids or polyps, coagulopathy, and endometrial pathology.
red_flags_zh: 急性大量出血合併血壓下降、心悸、暈厥屬急症，需立即就醫
停經後出血或不規則出血需排除內膜增生／癌變
易瘀青或家族出血病史提示凝血疾病
貧血症狀明顯（極度疲倦、氣短）
red_flags_en: Acute heavy bleeding with hypotension, palpitations, or syncope is an emergency — seek immediate care
Postmenopausal or irregular bleeding — rule out endometrial hyperplasia/carcinoma
Easy bruising or family bleeding history suggests coagulopathy
Marked anemia symptoms (severe fatigue, dyspnea)
records.western_context_zh: 常以補鐵、荷爾蒙或非荷爾蒙藥物減少出血，並針對結構性病因處理；此為文件對照用語，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with iron repletion, hormonal or non-hormonal agents to reduce bleeding, and treatment of structural causes. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_en: Scanty or infrequent menstruation refers to reduced flow or shortened menses. Causes include endocrine imbalance (PCOS, thyroid, hyperprolactinemia), endometrial damage (intrauterine adhesions), low body weight, and stress.
red_flags_zh: 合併泌乳、頭痛或視野缺損需排除腦下垂體病變

red_flags_en: Galactorrhea, headache, or visual-field loss — rule out pituitary pathology
Sharp drop in flow after recent uterine surgery suggests intrauterine adhesions
Possible pregnancy
Marked weight loss or over-exercise trending toward amenorrhea
records.western_context_zh: 處置聚焦於矯正潛在內分泌或結構因素，並依生育需求處理；此為文件對照用語，非治療指示。
